༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro'i smre bshags bzhugs so/oṃ/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro dbang phyug khro rgyal gtso/ /bde chen gnyis med yum gyi dbyings su sbyor/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro'i smre bshags bzhugs so/ oṃ/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro dbang phyug khro rgyal gtso/ /bde chen gnyis med yum gyi dbyings su sbyor/ /bdag tu lta ba'i nga rgyal 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol/ /ta na'i gnas mchog sgrol ba gnas ma stobs/ /ga ṇa'i gnas mchog sbyor ba byin ma brlabs/ /dpal chen khro rgyal thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol/ /rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa tan gaṇa ni/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa lnga yi yon tan bsam yas kyis/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig /dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum thugs rje yis/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod la/ /bar gcod byed pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /grub pa'i 'bras bu dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ hūm̐/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dbang phyug go ri brgyad/ /siṃ ha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad/ /rta gdong la sogs 'bar ma khro mo bzhi/ /dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol/ oṃ/ sgom sgrub dus las g.yel bar gyur pa yis/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas mchog bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /dus drug mchod pa'i tshul du ma sbyar ba/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems dang māṃ sa rakta dang*/ /dri chen dri chu go ku da ha na/ /gnyis med sbyar ba'i sman mchog a mṛ tas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig /'bar ba'i sku mchog rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bdud dang srin po ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa po la zhal ston la/ /bar gcod byed pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog oṃ/ sha za mkha' 'gro dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad/ /srid gsum rgyal mo dur khrod brgyad kyi yum/ /gtso mo mngon spyod ma bdun 'khor dang bcas/ /dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol/ /mchod pa lo zla'i dus las 'das pa dang*/

/rdzas dang phyag rgya dus 'dir ma rdzogs shing*/ /sha khrag dmar gyi dam las g.yel gyur te/ /sha za mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /dur khrod rdzas mchog thal chen ba su ta/ /sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa rab sbyar te/ /bhandha'i snod du dmar chen bskyil ba 'dis/ /sha za mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig oṃ/ sngon tshe dpal chen khro rgyal spyan snga ru/ /sus kyang ma bcol nyid kyis zhal 'ches te/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen pos 'khor srungs shig oṃ/ las kyi mkha' 'gro phyi yi rnal 'byor bzhi/ /bdag nyid chen mo la sogs ma mo'i tshogs/ /lha dang lha min phyogs bcu'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol/ /lta ba mthos pas spyod lam rtsings pa dang*/ /nya stong gso sbyong dus las g.yel gyur cing*/ /gnyid chang rmongs pas phyi mchod ma bskangs pa/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /dam tshig lhag ma kha chu'i 'od zer 'phro/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin a mṛ ta/ /sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa chen po 'dis/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig oṃ/ stong khams yongs su 'chol bar gyur mod kyang*/ /bdag ni rdo rje'i dam las mi 'da' zhing*/ /dpal chen sgom sgrub las la brtson lags na/ /skyes chen khyed kyi thugs dam mnyes gyur cig /dur khrod klong dgu'i mkha' 'gro rnam bzhi'i tshogs/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ci 'dra ba/ /byams mgon khyed kyi thugs la de ltar gsal/ /dmyal tshogs me ltar 'bar ba zhi bar mdzod/ /thugs rje'i gdung 'tshob rig 'dzin bdag gis ni/ /dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /'da' ka rdo rje dam tshig mchog gsum po/ /rgyal ba'i bka' las 'da' bar mi bgyid la/ /gsang sngags 'chol bar 'gyur gyis bsal dka' mod/

/nyams dang tshogs 'dres gyur pa bskangs so 'tshal/ /blo sems rtul bas skyon can ma rtogs te/ /rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol bshags na/ /grogs ngan nyams grib skyon gyis ma gos shing*/ /nyams pa rnams la chad pa'i sgo bcad de/ /'di phyi'i rkyen dang sgrib par mi 'gyur bar/ /phra men sprul tshogs khyed kyis dbye bsal mdzad du gsol// //
